title.narrative: Developing digital talent for social and labour inclusion in LAC

description.narrative:
The project "Development of Digital Talent for the Social and Labor Inclusion in Latin America and the Caribbean" aims to promote social and labor inclusion by developing digital talent, with a special focus on vulnerable populations such as indigenous communities, migrants, and persons with disabilities. Led by UNESCO and funded by Huawei, this initiative has a duration of 36 months and includes key actions such as building capacities to establish and manage Centers of Excellence in digital talent, training programs for teachers, and strengthening capacities within ministries of education.
The project prioritizes gender equality, environmental sustainability, and educational innovation, contributing to the development of inclusive and sustainable digital economies in the region. The pilot phase will focus on Mexico, directly impacting over 100 beneficiaries, including youth, women, and educational staff, and serving as a replicable model for Latin America and the Caribbean.
